title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings: reproducibility artifact
description: Code, frozen derived inputs, results and six-page author manuscript V4, prepared for the general track of ESANN 2027. Adds the verified zero-loss control, an initial-certification-versus-tolerance figure and clearer autonomous exposition. Original benchmark and positive-tolerance trajectories are preserved. All extensions are retrospective. See README.rst for reproduction, interpretation and licenses. No acceptance claim.
